scams.name: The Express Kidnapping Taxi
scams.avoidance: Book taxis through your hotel or use InDriver/Uber Never get into an unmarked vehicle If in a bad situation, stay calm — express kidnappings in Lima are usually 'safe' as long as you comply and don't resist
scams.location: Airport Jorge Chávez, Miraflores, San Isidro

scams.name: The Fake Tour Operator
scams.avoidance: Book Machu Picchu only through the official site tuboleto.cultura.pe Use well-reviewed operators on TripAdvisor or verified by your hotel Get every inclusion in writing with a receipt

scams.name: The Predatory Pricing
scams.avoidance: Always confirm prices before committing Eat at restaurants with menus and listed prices Learn basic price phrases in Spanish
scams.location: Markets, tourist areas, restaurants without menus

scams.name: The Mustard Smear
scams.avoidance: If something hits you, step away from all strangers immediately and check your belongings first Keep your bag in front of you in crowded areas Decline all unsolicited 'help'

scams.name: The Fake Police ID Check
scams.avoidance: Real Peruvian police don't conduct 'money inspections' on the street Offer to walk to the nearest police station instead — they will refuse Ask to see a badge and official ID number (real officers won't object)
scams.location: Lima Centro, near banks, bus stations

scams.name: The ATM Helper
scams.avoidance: Always shield your PIN with your body and hand If someone approaches at an ATM, cancel your transaction and find another machine Use ATMs inside bank branches only
scams.location: ATMs near tourist areas in Miraflores and Barranco
